description: 5 test prompts × 5 binary assertions = 25 checks. Each prompt describes a fixture repo with known characteristics; each assertion is a binary pass/fail check on the expected output.

prompts.description: Clean registry-based architecture with incremental git history

fixtureCharacteristics.extensionMechanism: manifest directory — new capability = 1 new file

assertions.rationale: Registry pattern scores 18-20 (1 new file, 0 existing modified)
4 concepts scores 15; tolerance for 1 missed concept gives 12
All files under 200 SLOC scores 10; tolerance for 90%+ gives 8
Incremental git history scores 10; tolerance for 1 big-bang gives 7
Clean architecture should score >= 75

prompts.description: High coupling: orchestrator with 12 imports, 3 files above critical fan-out threshold

fixtureCharacteristics.extensionMechanism: if/elif dispatch — new capability = 3 files modified

assertions.rationale: 3 files above critical threshold scores ≤5 (max 10)
Coupling violations must produce P0 recommendation with file citation
Highest-impact violator (12 imports) cited first
if/elif dispatch means 3+ existing files modified (score ≤10)
High coupling + type-dispatch architecture cannot score >= 75

prompts.description: LOC violations: 6 out of 20 files exceed 200 SLOC (70% compliant)

assertions.rationale: 70% compliant scores exactly 5 (70-89% band)
Each over-200 file must appear in evidence
Largest violator (450 SLOC) must be cited by file path
Highest-SLOC violator should generate a recommendation
SELF_SCORE decision must be emitted for Cat 5 scoring

prompts.description: Big-bang architecture: single 5000-line initial commit, no intermediate states

fixtureCharacteristics.gitHistory: 1 initial commit (+5000 lines), then small fixes

assertions.rationale: Big-bang initial commit with no intermediate states scores 0-2
Evidence must cite the big-bang commit pattern
Big-bang architecture warrants at least P1 recommendation
Score never exceeds max for the category
Projected score after fixes must be >= current total

prompts.description: High complecting: top-5 files each braid 2-3 independent concerns

assertions.rationale: 6-10 complecting instances across top-5 files scores 4
Each complecting file must appear in evidence
Evidence notes must describe the complecting concerns
Complecting violations must cite Hickey's braid principle
8 complecting instances cannot achieve Exemplary rating
